info.name: PISTRIK API
info.description:
This is a workspace of Estonian Waste Information System (PISTRIK) REST API service request with example responses and documentation regarding specific API request.

More thorough documentation is accessible in estonian on GitHub WIKI: [https://github.com/kemitgituser/pistrik-api-documentation/wiki](https://github.com/kemitgituser/pistrik-api-documentation/wiki)

Email: [pistrik@envir.ee](https://mailto:pistrik@envir.ee)

header.description: Specifies the member/subsystem that is used as a service client - an entity that initiates the service call.
User whose action initiated the request. The user ID should be prefixed with two-letter ISO country code.
Unique identifier for this message. It is RECOMMENDED to use universally unique identifiers. If X-Road-Id is not provided, it SHALL be generated by the consumer Security Server.

Identifies received application, issue or document that was the cause of the service request. This field may be used by the client information system to connect service requests (and responses) to working procedures.
The purpose of this header is to allow sending of additional information to the X-Road service providers in case when service client represents third party while issuing a query.

response.name: 200 - List of all countries
